Ben / Laura — forwarding Sam's note + amendment and our usage extract. Can you review and confirm the numbers below? I recommend issuing a single credit memo (negative invoice) applied to their next invoice unless they request a refund.

Quick calc (from usage_report_Mar2026):
- Seat price: €30.00 per seat / month
- Billed: 50 seats for full March (31 days) = 50 * €30 = €1,500.00
- Actual seat-days: 50 seats * 9 days (Mar 1–9) + 35 seats * 22 days (Mar 10–31) = 450 + 770 = 1,220 seat-days
- Billed seat-days: 50 seats * 31 days = 1,550 seat-days
- Overbilled seat-days: 1,550 - 1,220 = 330 seat-days
- Net overcharge (seats) = 330 * (€30 / 31) = €319.35 (net)

Add-on: RT-Analytics add-on (€400/month) was activated on 2026-03-12 (20 days active):
- Full month billed: €400.00
- Prorated actual: €400 * 20/31 = €258.06 (net)
- Overbilled add-on = €141.94 (net)

Totals (net): €319.35 + €141.94 = €461.29 (net)
VAT (22% assumed): €461.29 * 0.22 = €101.48
Credit total (incl. VAT) = €562.77

Recommendations / questions:
1) Issue a single credit memo for €562.77 (incl. VAT) and apply to next invoice. If TheraNova prefers, we can refund to card; processing refund takes ~3–5 business days after approval.
2) If TheraNova wants reverse-charge (zero-rate) due to their VAT ID, we need confirmation and we will re-issue the credit net only (no VAT).
3) Accounting: use GL code 7003 (subscription credits) and tag invoice as credit_memo/20260321/TN.

Laura — can you draft the credit memo PDF and confirm the invoice tagging? Ben — I can follow up with Sam to confirm refund vs credit choice.

Thanks,
Jasmine
